facts: GLA Planning publishes a Site Allocations dataset for London
The GLA Site Allocations page exposes a GeoPackage of approximately 5.11 MB
The Site Allocations GeoPackage is published in EPSG:27700
The GLA describes its GIS site-allocation boundaries as indicative
The GLA advises contacting the relevant London borough to confirm accuracy
GLA indicative overlap therefore cannot by itself satisfy borough-confirmed positive binding
London Datastore publishes borough Planning Local Plan GeoPackages
The Enfield borough package is planning_local_plan_data_10.gpkg
The Havering borough package is planning_local_plan_data_16.gpkg
The Lambeth borough package is planning_local_plan_data_22.gpkg
Those borough packages are published in EPSG:27700
London Datastore also publishes query-capable Data Service links for the borough datasets
Planning Data documents coordinate queries using latitude and longitude
Planning Data coordinate queries return geometries intersecting the supplied point for selected datasets
Planning Data documents geometry-relation values including intersects, within, contains and disjoint
Planning Data says geometry WKT coordinates should use EPSG:4326
Planning Data documents limit and offset pagination
Planning Data says there is no batch endpoint for per-property queries
Planning Data recommends bulk downloads for large extraction workflows
Planning Data documents CSV and GeoJSON downloads and other formats where applicable
The Development Plan Document type dataset currently contains 16 document types
Its collector last ran on 27 July 2026
Planning Data entity 5280013 is the authoritative Site allocations category
The Site allocations category entity has no geometry
A taxonomy category is therefore not parcel membership
Planning Data guidance accepts GeoJSON, GML and GeoPackage as publication formats
Dataset or endpoint availability is source-discovery evidence rather than candidate membership
No new exact relation is promoted from GLA or Planning Data availability in this wave
